feeds.title: RollerCoaster » Pregnancy
feeds.description: Answering the endless questions that mothers can have during pregnancy, not just the changes taking place with your baby but also with you and your body. RollerCoaster.ie is a parenting website, that provides mums and dads with 1000s of articles to inform and entertain throughout all stages of their parenting journey. For the Ups & Downs of Pregnancy & Parenting read our blog, you will find it helpful.

feeds.title: Pregnancy & Baby Fair Blog
feeds.description: The Pregnancy & Baby Fair is Ireland's biggest, best, and only exhibition covering all things pregnancy & baby related. Our blog writes informative articles about challenges in pregnancy such as overdue, for new moms, breastfeeding, baby names, and more.

feeds.title: DoulaCare Academy Blog
feeds.description: DoulaCare Ireland is the brainchild of Mary Tighe and Jen Crawford. Mary and Jen are two of the most experienced doulas in Ireland and are widely known and respected for the work that they do. Ireland's leading Doula Agency, offering support and encouragement through your pregnancy, birth & early parenting journey.

feeds.title: Maternity & More Blog
feeds.description: Maternity and More is the maternity fashion side of Cherche la Femme. We sell Maternity clothes, Nursing bras, and Maternity tights alongside our regular underwear. We are a before, during, and after Maternity shop, stocking affordable stylish brands such as Jojo Maman Bebe and Mamalicious. Here at Cherche La Femme, we are always looking to supply the best quality products to our customers.

feeds.title: LloydsPharmacy Blog » Pregnancy
feeds.description: At LloydsPharmacy we believe that health is more than the opposite of being sick, and it is more than just how our bodies feel. It means being able to live life to the fullest and having a positive feeling. As exciting as the experience is, we know that becoming a parent for the first time can also be a scary one. Our teams are here to help you through your journey, at every stage. We can offer you advice and support on the best pregnancy vitamins, newborn care, and how to help with some of your pregnancy symptoms.

feeds.title: MagicMum » Pregnancy
feeds.description: MagicMum is an Irish website for mums and mums-to-be. MagicMum offers an online haven where Mums and mums-to-be can pop in for information, advice, support, friendly chat, or a laugh! Our pregnancy section covers the experiences of mothers and guides the mother's-to-be, from a difficult pregnancy to exercises and everything is covered here.

feeds.title: My Expert Midwife Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to My Expert Midwife we're here to educate, empower and help you manage the physical side effects of pregnancy, childbirth, and being a new mum. We have a pre and post-natal product range, designed to tackle taboos around pregnancy and childbirth for new and expectant mums. From preconception to post-delivery, you will all the relevant articles in our blog.

feeds.title: Ultrascan Ireland
feeds.description: Ultrascan provides a range of baby scan packages that cater to most stages of pregnancy, from 8 weeks pregnant up to 38 weeks pregnant. Each of our scans delivers a unique experience for the expectant family. Welcome to the homepage for all our blog posts. Please take some time to read all our helpful and informative blog posts aimed at helping new parents.
